case_name: Burbon v. Fox News Network, LLC
court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York
claim_type: FoxNews.com inaccessible to blind and low-vision users; missing alt text, dead links, no keyboard navigation
outcome: Settled (terms confidential); Fox News agreed to address accessibility concerns

sources.name: Top Class Actions — Fox News website not accessible to blind, class action says
Level Access — ADA website compliance lawsuits: high profile cases

summary_one_line: Fox News class action (2018) for inaccessible news website; demonstrates that media and content-driven businesses face the same ADA exposure as retailers.
notes: Plaintiff claimed FoxNews.com lacked alt text for all images, contained dead links, and was not usable with keyboard navigation. Case settled 2019 with confidential terms. Settlement terms not publicly available — note this clearly in any report. Useful for illustrating that content/news businesses are not exempt.
